title: X óta: Since X, Up to Now

sections.title: A starting point with no end point
sections.content: You already know -tól/-től ... -ig for a span with a start and an end. óta marks just a starting point that carries on right up to now, with no -ig needed — it simply follows the starting point word, with no other suffix attached.

items.english: I've been attending university since September.

sections.content: Notice the verb stays in the present tense (tanulok, not a past form) — from Hungarian's point of view the action is still happening right now, so óta pairs with the tense you already know best.
